title: Decide @everyone channel-override targetId and MemoryBackend @everyone floor
description: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 L700/L728: @everyone is implicit, has no SpaceRole id and is not in Space.roles, so no ChannelPermission (targetType role, L772) can target it; §Space Permission Resolution step 2 (L1622) still applies role-targeted records 'matching the member's roles'. The @everyone permission floor has no wire field either. JMAP-y3f2.1 landed the resolver with the reference MemoryBackend floor empty (status quo, test member_with_only_everyone_role_lacks_permissions) and @everyone overrides unaddressable, so a role-less member can neither view nor send in channels. Options: (A) targetId = Space id addresses @everyone (Discord convention), floor configurable on MemoryBackend defaulting to view+send; (B) reserved literal targetId '@everyone'; (C) keep as is and add a spec sentence. Needs a jmap-chat-spec sentence whichever is chosen. Recommendation: A.
notes:
Mark 2026-10-21: option A. ChannelPermission with targetType role and targetId = the Space id addresses @everyone; MemoryBackend @everyone floor configurable, default view+send. Needs a jmap-chat-spec sentence (spec bead) before/with the code.
Spec landed: jmap-chat-spec c506844 (ChannelPermission targetId; Space Permission Resolution step 2).
